monash.desc:
Researchers at Monash University have developed the low FODMAP diet and a corresponding app to assist in the management of gastrointestinal symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The Monash University FODMAP diet works by swapping foods high in fermentable carbohydrates (FODMAPs), with low FODMAP alternatives. Around 75% of people with IBS experience symptom relief on a low FODMAP diet.

The app comes directly from the research team at Monash and includes the following:

- General information about the FODMAP diet and IBS.
- Easy to understand tutorials to guide you through the app and the 3-Step FODMAP diet.
- A Food Guide detailing the FODMAP content for hundreds of foods using a simple 'traffic light system'. 
- A list of branded products that have been certified by Monash as low FODMAP.
- A collection of over 70 nutritious, low FODMAP recipes.
- Functions that allow you to create your own shopping list and add notes to individual foods
- A Diary that enables you to record food eaten, IBS symptoms, bowel habits and stress levels. The Diary will also guide you through step 2 of the diet - FODMAP reintroduction.
- The ability to adjust units of measurement (metric or imperial) and activate colour blindness assistance.

nerva.desc:
Fix the miscommunication between your gut and brain. Designed for people living with IBS, functional dyspepsia (FD), GERD, bloating symptoms, and other gut–brain disorders - as well as those seeking additional support alongside IBD care - Nerva is a personalized gut–brain program that supports symptom management through daily sessions, practical tools, and structured guidance.


Target the root cause

Many people spend years cutting out foods in an effort to calm their gut - a difficult path that can miss what’s really driving symptoms. In disorders of gut–brain interaction (DGBIs), the root cause is gut–brain hypersensitivity.

After a trigger like illness, antibiotics, or prolonged stress, the nerves in the gut can become over-reactive. Even once the gut tissue heals, the nervous system may keep the alarm turned up. Normal digestion, gas, or movement are then misread as danger - leading to pain, bloating, reflux, urgency, constipation, or diarrhea.

Diets and medications can reduce symptoms temporarily, but they don’t retrain this signaling system. That’s why symptoms often return or shift over time.

Lasting relief means calming the nervous system and restoring healthy gut–brain communication - where the symptoms actually start.


How Nerva helps

Nerva is a structured gut–brain program that helps you practice brain-gut techniques shown to support a calmer response to gut sensations. Over the program you'll learn to:

- Respond differently to uncomfortable gut signals
- Practice calming the gut–brain stress response
- Build daily habits that support digestive comfort
 

Tailored to you

No two guts are the same. Nerva adapts your program to your symptoms, triggers, and progress - using AI to adjust the coaching and guidance as you go. The sessions, the tools you receive, and the coaching you follow are all shaped around your experience.


Evidence-based

Unlike most apps, Nerva is built on clinical research. In a randomized controlled trial at Monash University, Nerva helped 81% of people significantly manage their gastrointestinal symptoms. Since then, more than 300,000 people have used Nerva, and over 11,000 healthcare providers recommend it.


Features of Nerva

- Daily 15-minute sessions designed to retrain gut-brain miscommunication
- Flare-up tools for pain, bloating, constipation, reflux and diarrhea
- Long-term maintenance plan to keep symptoms under control after the program
- AI personalization to tailor the program to your selected triggers and progress


Who is the team behind Nerva?

Nerva was built by Dr. Simone Peters, GI psychophysiologist, together with clinicians, dietitians, and researchers. Many of us live with gut conditions ourselves. 


Member stories

“Nerva has really worked for me. I’ve been using the app for several months now, and I’ve noticed that I’m experiencing less negative instances with my stomach. I would highly recommend to anyone - absolutely worth the subscription”

Disclaimer: Nerva is a self-guided program that may help people self-manage and live well with a diagnosed disorder of the gut-brain interaction. It is not a substitute for professional medical care, diagnosis, or treatment, and has not been evaluated by the FDA, TGA, MHRA, or equivalent bodies. Do not change prescribed medication or treatment without professional advice. Some content is personalized or generated by AI for educational and wellness purposes only. It is not therapy or mental health care, is not from a licensed professional, and is not monitored in real time. ibsbuddy.desc:
IBS Buddy is a free, science-backed app designed to help people find lasting IBS relief using gut-directed hypnotherapy, a clinically proven approach for Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).

The gut-brain connection affects IBS. Stress, anxiety, and nervous system dysregulation can directly trigger symptoms like bloating, abdominal pain, constipation, diarrhoea, and discomfort. IBS Buddy works by retraining this gut–brain pathway using structured hypnotherapy techniques shown to reduce IBS symptoms over time.

A proven 14-week IBS program
IBS Buddy follows a 14-week gut-directed hypnotherapy program based on the North Carolina (NC) protocol, one of the most widely researched and scientifically validated approaches for IBS management.

This protocol has been studied in clinical settings and shown to help improve:
• Abdominal pain and cramps
• Bloating and gut discomfort
• Diarrhoea and constipation
• Stress-related IBS flare-ups
• Overall quality of life in IBS patients

The program is progressive, structured, and designed for long-term symptom relief—not short-term fixes.

How does gut-directed hypnotherapy helps IBS?
Gut-directed hypnotherapy focuses on calming the nervous system and improving communication between the brain and the digestive system. By reducing gut sensitivity and stress responses, many people experience fewer IBS symptoms and better digestive control.

IBS Buddy guides you through this process with:
• Clinically structured hypnotherapy sessions
• Simple, easy-to-follow audio guidance
• A gradual 14-week program designed for consistency
• Tools to support relaxation and gut calm
No prior experience with hypnotherapy is needed.

Free IBS relief — no subscriptions
Unlike many IBS apps, IBS Buddy is completely free.
There are no subscriptions, paywalls, or hidden charges. The goal is to make evidence-based IBS relief accessible to everyone living with Irritable Bowel Syndrome.

Who IBS Buddy is for
• IBS Buddy is suitable for people who:
• Have been diagnosed with Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
• Experience chronic gut symptoms triggered by stress
• Are looking for a non-drug, science-backed approach
• Want a structured program rather than generic advice
• Prefer guided, evidence-based gut therapy

Not medical advice
IBS Buddy is designed to support IBS symptom management and gut health. It does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.

Start your IBS relief journey
If you’re looking for a clinically proven, gut-focused approach to managing IBS, IBS Buddy offers a simple, structured, and free way to begin.

Download IBS Buddy and start calming your gut—one session at a time.
